$comment: Single source of truth for docs/MILESTONES.md. Edit this file, then run `npm run progress`. CI runs `npm run progress:check`. Statuses: done | in_progress | not_started | blocked | deferred. Evidence entries are repo-relative paths (validated) or commit hashes. blockedBy entries are blocker ids (below) or item ids.
title: Bhaktara milestone tracker

milestones.title: Foundation
milestones.goal: Repository, app shell, Firebase/R2 environments, telemetry services, CI and tooling.

items.title: Repository setup
items.notes: Private GitHub repo anon987/Bhaktara with main/develop branches.

items.title: React Native + strict TypeScript, Android-first
items.notes: Expo SDK 57 dev client, RN 0.86, strict tsconfig; ARM64 debug build verified on Samsung SM_E076B.

items.title: Keep the ios/ project
items.notes: Generated ios/ project kept in the repo; never built (iOS phase, D-009).

items.title: Platform service interfaces (doc 05)
items.notes: Wallpaper, ringtone, media-save, share and notification contracts with Android/iOS stubs that report unavailable. Native implementations land with the M1 save/set items.

items.title: Navigation shell
items.notes: Five tabs (D-028) with typed routes, banner target whitelist and animated tab bar.

items.title: Theme and design tokens
items.notes: Tokens authored from the written design system (doc 04), not from a Stitch export (see m0-design-export).

items.title: Hindi/English i18n framework
items.notes: Typed hi/en string table; onboarding asks for language only (D-029).

items.title: Firebase local emulator environment (demo-bhaktara)
items.notes: Auth + Firestore emulators, guarded seed script, emulator test suite in CI.

items.title: Firebase dev project (bhaktara-dev)
items.notes: Spark plan. Firestore asia-south1 with delete protection; rules and 8 composite indexes deployed; placeholder catalog seeded (13 items, 5 deities, 2 banners).

items.title: Firebase staging project (bhaktara-staging)
items.notes: Not created. Client config already accepts the project ID.

items.title: Firebase prod project (bhaktara-prod)
items.notes: Not created. Release signing fingerprints are also needed (see m4-release-signing).

items.title: Anonymous guest auth (D-016)
items.notes: Persistent anonymous sessions in emulator, cloud and native (React Native Firebase) modes; native session restore verified on device against bhaktara-dev.

items.title: Google sign-in with guest link/merge (D-017, D-020)
items.notes: Google provider is enabled on bhaktara-dev, but the app's sign-in button reports unavailable. Must land before live leagues.

items.title: Server-owned user profile provisioning
items.notes: Rules deny client profile creation, so a Cloud Function must create profiles. Can be built against emulators; cloud deploy needs Blaze.

items.title: Analytics service
items.notes: React Native Firebase Analytics behind a typed service (D-048). Collection disabled in firebase.json until the privacy policy ships; only part of the doc 13 event list is defined.

items.title: Crashlytics
items.notes: React Native Firebase Crashlytics with JS handlers installed at startup; collection disabled until the privacy policy ships.

items.title: Remote Config
items.notes: In-app defaults for the doc 11 ad switches (off) and a validated media_base_url override; fetched once per launch.

items.title: App Check (monitor mode)
items.notes: App Check API enabled on bhaktara-dev; debug provider in debug builds with the phone's debug token registered. Play Integrity for release is still unregistered.

items.title: Core components
items.notes: Shared UI kit, content cards, dialogs, devotional placeholder art, catalog state notices.

items.title: CI
items.notes: GitHub Actions: typecheck, lint, Jest, Android export, plus a Firebase emulator job (Java 21, ffmpeg).

items.title: MCP: Stitch server
items.notes: No Stitch project or designs are linked to the repo (doc 23 §3).

items.title: MCP: Firebase server
items.notes: Firebase plugin configured at user scope in Claude Code; project operations so far ran through the Firebase CLI. Not recorded in project docs.

items.title: MCP: Cloudflare server
items.notes: Cloudflare Claude Code plugin (skills + MCP) installed at user scope.

items.title: Project .mcp.json with environment-variable secrets
items.notes: No .mcp.json in the repo; servers are configured at user scope instead. Decide whether a project file is still wanted.

items.title: R2 dev bucket (bhaktara-media-dev)
items.notes: APAC location hint; public reads via the rate-limited r2.dev URL (D-047); public writes return 401.

items.title: R2 upload API token (dev bucket only)
items.notes: MEDIA_R2.md records no API token yet; media:publish and content:import need it for real uploads.

items.title: R2 staging and prod buckets
items.notes: Not created; they need media-staging/media domains on a Bhaktara-owned zone.

items.title: R2 CORS
items.notes: Public GET/HEAD with Range for audio/video seeking; applied to the dev bucket.

items.title: R2 custom domain (`media.<domain>`)
items.notes: Required before the first public release because builds embed the media base URL (D-047).

items.title: R2 CDN cache rules
items.notes: Objects are uploaded with immutable Cache-Control, but r2.dev is not CDN-cached; cache rules need the custom domain.

items.title: R2 lifecycle rules
items.notes: No lifecycle rules configured.

items.title: Export Stitch DESIGN.md → theme tokens
items.notes: docs/design/DESIGN.md was written from the Markdown specs because no Stitch export existed.

milestones.title: Content core + CMS core
milestones.goal: Real content browsing, playback and saves in the app; admin CMS for content, media, banners and Home sections; launch catalog seeded.

items.title: App: Home with CMS-driven sections
items.notes: App renders homeFeeds/{language}; buildHomeFeed (dirty flag + 5-min schedule, claim-checked transactional writes) implemented and emulator-tested. Pending: Functions deploy (Blaze), on-device check, FESTIVALS/CHALLENGES/LEAGUE sections.

items.title: App: Explore
items.notes: Virtualized list with category/deity filters and cursor pagination over Firestore; verified on device against bhaktara-dev.

items.title: App: content detail
items.notes: Direct Firestore lookup by ID with R2 image keys and placeholder-art fallback. Its play/save/set/share actions are tracked as separate items.

items.title: App: audio player (background playback, lock-screen controls)
items.notes: Verified on Samsung SM_E076B on 2026-10-05: streamed from R2, background media service and media session active, lock-screen/media-button controls routed to Bhaktara.

items.title: App: status video player
items.notes: Verified on Samsung SM_E076B on 2026-10-05: tap-to-play status video; saved video720 byte-identical to R2.

items.title: App: search (Firestore searchTokens, D-032/D-035)
items.notes: Normalized prefix tokens with Hindi transliteration variants; tokens are generated by the seed/import scripts until a publish function exists.

items.title: App: favorites
items.notes: Account-backed favorites (users/{uid}/favorites) with optimistic updates, persistent retry queue and one-time device migration; emulator-tested. Merged to develop; needs on-device verification. Google-account merge (D-017) pending.

items.title: App: save wallpaper
items.notes: Implemented (MediaStore Pictures/Bhaktara). Set-wallpaper verified on device; the Save action itself not yet confirmed on device.

items.title: App: set wallpaper
items.notes: Verified on Samsung SM_E076B on 2026-10-05: WallpaperManager records com.bhaktara.app as the last setter.

items.title: App: save ringtone
items.notes: Verified on Samsung SM_E076B on 2026-10-05: saved to Ringtones/Bhaktara via MediaStore.

items.title: App: set ringtone
items.notes: Verified on Samsung SM_E076B on 2026-10-05: Modify-system-settings flow granted, ringtone set (owner confirmed).

items.title: Admin: auth and roles
items.notes: Code complete and emulator-verified: role claims + checks in every callable, grant-role script, admin web sign-in and role gate. Deploy (Functions, Hosting) needs Blaze.

items.title: Admin: content CRUD with DRAFT→PUBLISHED workflow (D-036)
items.notes: Code complete and emulator-verified: content callables with D-036 workflow + checklist gating, admin web list/editor/transitions. Deploy needs Blaze.

items.title: Media pipeline: image variants
items.notes: Code complete and emulator-verified: image variants via CLI importer and the Cloud Run processMedia service (presigned staging upload → renditions → final keys). Cloud Run deploy needs Blaze.

items.title: Media pipeline: audio normalization
items.notes: Code complete and emulator-verified: loudness-normalized AAC/MP3 via CLI importer and processMedia. Cloud Run deploy needs Blaze.

items.title: Media pipeline: video renditions
items.notes: Code complete and emulator-verified: 720p H.264 + poster via CLI importer and processMedia. Cloud Run deploy needs Blaze.

items.title: Admin: banner manager
items.notes: Code complete and emulator-verified: banner callables + admin web banner manager. Deploy needs Blaze.

items.title: Admin: home section manager
items.notes: Code complete and emulator-verified: Home manager callables (layout, preview, rebuild); admin web screen for it still to add. Deploy needs Blaze.

items.title: Admin: audit log
items.notes: Code complete and emulator-verified: audit entry per mutation in the same transaction + admin web audit viewer. Deploy needs Blaze.

items.title: Seed: import tooling
items.notes: Manifest-driven content:import (validation, doc 12 §5 checklist, R2 publish, idempotent upserts) plus seed:emulators/seed:dev.

items.title: Seed: 100+ bhajans
items.notes: Only synthetic placeholder records exist.

items.title: Seed: 30+ aartis
items.notes: Needs source text (doc 12 §3).

items.title: Seed: 50+ mantras
items.notes: Needs source text.

items.title: Seed: 30+ chalisas
items.notes: Needs source text.

items.title: Seed: 200+ wallpapers across 14+ deities
items.notes: Deity coverage depends on the final taxonomy.

items.title: Seed: 100+ ringtones
items.notes: 20–30 s clips.

items.title: Seed: 20+ deity profiles
items.notes: 5 provisional fixture deities only.

milestones.title: Habit layer
milestones.goal: Sadhana tools with server-authoritative XP, streaks, challenges and badges.

items.title: Sadhana: daily plan
items.notes: Local Today task list with a 04:00 day boundary (D-024); not server-backed.

items.title: Sadhana: jaap
items.notes: Persistent local 108-bead counter; server practice sessions pending. Open question: leftover beads from a previous day count toward today.

items.title: Sadhana: meditation timer
items.notes: Wall-clock local timer survives backgrounding; not anti-cheat evidence until server sessions exist.

items.title: Sadhana: prayer checklist
items.notes: Local checklist only.

items.title: Sadhana: history
items.notes: Local history sorted by date; no server record.

items.title: XP (single currency, D-023)
items.notes: UI shows non-authoritative sample values only.

items.title: Levels and ranks (D-027)
items.notes: Sample rank display only.

items.title: Streak (server-authoritative, D-024/D-026)
items.notes: Rules already reject direct client progression writes.

items.title: Daily challenges
items.notes: Challenges tab is a preview.

items.title: Weekly challenges
items.notes: Challenges tab is a preview.

items.title: Badges
items.notes: Sample badges in Profile only.

items.title: Reward ledger
items.notes: Server-side only; no generic award-XP client endpoint.

items.title: Idempotent Cloud Functions for practice sessions and rewards
items.notes: ProgressionService contract exists in the client. Emulator-testable; cloud deploy needs Blaze.

items.title: Admin: challenge manager
items.notes: Builds on the M1 admin core.

items.title: Admin: badge manager
items.notes: Builds on the M1 admin core.

items.title: Seed: 8 weeks of challenges and the full V1 badge set
items.notes: Doc 18 targets.

milestones.title: Competition, Mandir, utilities, notifications
milestones.goal: Weekly leagues, Virtual Mandir, festival list and FCM notifications.

items.title: Weekly leagues (live from day 1, D-022)
items.notes: Guest league preview UI only; rules already block anonymous league reads (D-019).

items.title: League promotion/relegation
items.notes: Cohort sizing for a small user base is in doc 10.

items.title: Editable league display name with profanity filter (D-042)
items.notes: Default is first name + last initial from Google.

items.title: Virtual Mandir (simple, D-007)
items.notes: Local preview: first-visit deity choice and visual diya/flower offerings. Bell sound and aarti audio not implemented.

items.title: Festival list and detail (manual dates, D-034)
items.notes: No festival screen yet.

items.title: FCM setup and device registration
items.notes: Notification permission stub only. Cap: 2 pushes per day (D-043).

items.title: Seed: festivals (12 months), Mandir art, free and 10–20 special offerings
items.notes: Doc 18 targets.

milestones.title: Monetization + hardening
milestones.goal: Ads, security and App Check enforcement, performance, privacy compliance and closed testing.

items.title: AdMob native placements
items.notes: Placement exclusion zones are encoded (no ads near jaap/Mandir controls); no ad SDK yet.

items.title: Rewarded ads for saves and special offerings (D-038, D-040, D-041)
items.notes: UI copy discloses the future ad; WhatsApp share stays free.

items.title: Meta Audience Network via AdMob mediation (D-044)
Remote Config ad kill switch
items.notes: Ad switch defaults (off) exist in the app; nothing consumes them until ads ship.

items.title: Security rules review
items.notes: Deny-by-default rules deployed to dev; a formal pre-launch review has not happened.

items.title: Security rules emulator tests
items.notes: 6 rules/adapter scenarios plus import tests run in CI; coverage grows with each new collection.

items.title: App Check enforcement
items.notes: Monitor mode only. Play Integrity must be registered first; do not enforce before M4.

items.title: Offline and weak-network states
items.notes: Loading/error/empty/offline UI states exist (developer-simulated); native Firestore offline cache via RNF. No real network detection or sync queue.

items.title: Privacy policy
items.notes: Gates enabling Analytics/Crashlytics collection.

items.title: Enable Analytics/Crashlytics collection with consent flow (D-048)
items.notes: Config change in firebase.json plus rebuild; in-app privacy text must change at the same time.

items.title: Release signing key and fingerprints registered
items.notes: Only the shared debug keystore's SHA-1/SHA-256 are registered.

items.title: Play Console closed testing track
items.notes: Including any tester requirements for the developer account.

milestones.title: V1 public launch
milestones.goal: Staged Play Store rollout, then paid acquisition once quality is proven.

items.title: Staged rollout on Play Store
items.notes: Requires the production media domain (D-047).

items.title: Set crash-free and D1 retention thresholds
items.notes: To be set in the analytics round.

items.title: Paid acquisition after thresholds are verified at small spend
Name ringtones (D-008)
items.notes: Moved out of V1.

milestones.title: iOS phase
milestones.goal: Starts after the Android app shows traction and revenue (D-009).

items.title: First iOS build
items.notes: The ios/ project exists but has never been built.

items.title: iOS platform services (ringtone and wallpaper fallbacks)
items.notes: iOS stubs already implement the shared interfaces.

blockers.title: Enable the Firebase Blaze plan on bhaktara-dev
blockers.detail: The dev project is on Spark, which cannot deploy Cloud Functions. Admin CMS, profile provisioning and reward functions stay emulator-only until billing is enabled.

blockers.title: Buy a Bhaktara domain
blockers.detail: Needed for R2 custom domains (media-dev/media-staging/media), CDN cache rules and the staging/prod buckets. Required before the first public release (D-047).

blockers.title: P-11: canonical V1 deity list
blockers.detail: Confirm the final deity taxonomy in doc 18 §4, including whether Sai Baba is included. Blocks deity seeding, wallpaper coverage and Mandir config.

blockers.title: P-12: primary KPI (north-star metric)
blockers.detail: Candidate: % of DAU with a qualifying streak activity. Needed to set launch thresholds.

blockers.title: Google Play developer account readiness
blockers.detail: Confirm the developer account and any closed-testing tester requirements that apply to it before M4 closed testing.
